# Air Quality Report 2025 (Half-Year)

Issued by: Environmental Office, Transport Dept

## NO2 mean (micrograms per cubic metre)

| Period | Measured | Target |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2024 (full year) | 41 | none |
| 2025 (first half) | 39 | 35 for 2025 |

## Findings
- The 2025 target of 35 has still not been reached.
- Road transport accounts for 58% of NO2 in the city.
- The Council strategy aims for 20% fewer car trips by 2030 (see Strategy 2030).
